# Carbon fiber skid plates

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Select a carbon fiber laminate with Twintex or Kevlar cloth and bond hardened alloy aluminum skin. [t594]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Select a hybrid laminate combining carbon fiber for strength with Twintex or Kevlar ballistic cloth for impact resistance.
2. Consider bonding a thin outer skin of hardened alloy aluminum (approx 1/8 inch) to protect the composite from abrasion and rock gouging.

_Procedure reported by [t594]._

## Parts

- Carbon fiber laminate: Hybrid with Twintex or Kevlar [t594]
- [Partial] Hardened alloy aluminum plate: Approx 1/8 inch thick for outer skin [t594]
- Kevlar hybrid: For visual appeal and color acceptance [t594]
- Twintex ballistic cloth, Tegris: For impact resistance and IAD protection [t594]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use bar clamping to distribute tensile loading across a large area rather than simple clearance holes, which may rip out before the material yields. [t594]
